description: Eight-rung selectivity ladder for msmarco-query, picked from msmarco-query-contains-s42 to be even in log-selectivity (94.02% down to 0.00059%). Truth embedded per-query; binding via dataset checksum only. Extended with a second eight-rung ladder of curated question stems and topical literals (0.171 down to 2.3e-5), the way a query log is actually filtered.
